runs.name: merge queue
runs.outcome: not run: GitHub refused a merge queue
refusals: POST repos/<sandbox>/rulesets (merge_queue rule): HTTP 403 Upgrade to GitHub Pro or make this repository public to enable this feature.
PUT repos/<sandbox>/branches/main/protection: HTTP 403 Upgrade to GitHub Pro or make this repository public to enable this feature.
runs.needed: a merge queue on a private repository needs the organisation on GitHub Enterprise Cloud; or the sandbox made public, which this experiment was told not to do

real.leftBehind: nothing on GitHub: the three merged build branches deleted by hand (ship does not delete them), every issue closed, every pull request merged; local working copies removed by hand (operate does not remove them)
bugsFound: GitHub's REST rules read (rules/branches/<base>) is 403 on a private repository of a free plan; the pinned merge read it and would have stopped merge_failed. Now read as GraphQL ref.rules, which answers there.
setupOf took a repository rubrics folder handed in by the edge as the repository's pick even when fabrika.toml named none (the harness's table caught it). The pick now comes from fabrika.toml only.
